experiment.cpu_fallback: A-01 as an FP32 CPU GEMM, A-02 as host memory, the checkpoint write/verify on host tensors, no power reading; the benchmarks.md lint step is identical
experiment.title: Lab 23 L2: node-level bundle assumptions validated on this host, new evidence linted

log: best dense CPU GEMM 0.44 TFLOP/s; checkpoint write 0.69 GB/s, read 2.03 GB/s, verified True

needs: a BMC with DCMI/Redfish read access
not_runnable_parts.part: A-03 node power: sudo ipmitool dcmi power reading during >= 10 min of burn-in

needs: RDMA NICs on the GPU host
not_runnable_parts.part: A-10 RoCE MTU and NIC firmware: ibv_devinfo active_mtu, fw_ver; GPU-NIC affinity in topo -m
L3 B-02 row: 2-node all_reduce_perf busbw with /GDRDMA evidence

notes: GEMM: 3 warm-ups, >= 5 timed repetitions per size (CUDA events on the GPU). Checkpoint: 1 warm-up round trip, then >= 5; the last round trip is verified with SHA-256 over every tensor's bytes.
Checkpoint files go to /tmp inside the container (the image's overlay filesystem on the host's disk).
The benchmarks.md rows point at lab/l2/results/cpu-fallback/environment.json, the environment manifest this run writes.
